_note: Original Tamil-cinema-style punch dialogues written for this site (not quotes from films). `ta` is Tanglish (Tamil in English letters), `script` is optional Tamil script, `en` is the subtitle. Edit freely.

hero.ta: Idhu verum veedu illa sir… emotion!
hero.script: இது வெறும் வீடு இல்ல சார்… எமோஷன்!
hero.en: It's not just a house… it's an emotion.

heroSmall.ta: Veedu chinnadha irukkalaam… aana design mass-aa irukkanum!
heroSmall.en: The house can be small, but the design has to be mass.

error3d.ta: Model load aagala… current cut-aa irukkumo?
error3d.en: The 3D model didn't load — power cut, maybe? Here's a rendering instead.

philosophy.en: We don't just build houses — we build memories.

featured.ta: Paaka paaka pidikkum… idhu engal style.
featured.en: The more you look, the more you'll like it. That's our style.

services.ta: Nee ketta design naan tharen… budget-a mattum maraikkaadhe!
services.en: Ask for any design and you'll get it — just don't hide the budget!

process.ta: Plan illaama kattuna, adhu veedu illa — comedy track!
process.en: Build without a plan and it's not a house, it's a comedy track.

recognition.ta: Award-u ellam side dish… client smile dhaan main course!
recognition.en: Awards are the side dish. A client's smile is the main course.

testimonials.en: When the people speak, that's the verdict.

journal.ta: Filter kaapi kudichitte padinga… innum nalla puriyum.
journal.en: Read it with a filter coffee. It makes more sense that way.

cta.ta: Oru vaatti pesunga… nooru idea varum!
cta.en: Talk to us once — a hundred ideas will follow.

budget.en: Tell us the budget, sir — we'll work with it.

formSuccess.ta: Super-u! Request ready… aana idhu demo, yaarukkum pogala!
formSuccess.en: Super! Your request looks good — but this is a demo, so nothing was sent.

notFound.ta: Enna machan… vazhi thavari vandhuteenga pola!
notFound.en: Looks like you took a wrong turn, machan.

notFoundSub.en: We haven't built this page yet.

empty.ta: Inga onnum illa... vera page ponga!
empty.en: Searched till my eyes hurt — nothing here.

materials.ta: Teak-u, granite-u, Athangudi-u… ellam semma combo!
materials.en: Teak, granite and Athangudi tiles — what a combination.

transformations.ta: Munnadi paarunga… appuram paarunga… vithiyaasam theriyum!
transformations.en: Look at the before, then the after — you'll see the difference.

contact.ta: Phone pannunga, mail pannunga… pakkathula irundha nerula vaanga oru coffee kudichite pesuvom!
contact.en: Call us, email us — and if you're nearby, come over for coffee.

experience.ta: Mouse-a pudichu suthunga… veedu odi poga maattadhu!
experience.en: Grab the mouse and spin it — the house won't run away.

studio.en: It'll be simple — and it'll be brilliant.
